# TDrive v3.1.1

This patch fixes Linux Mint and other Linux desktop launch paths that could
still show a blank window. The AppImage desktop entry now starts through the
bundled launcher, and Linux startup applies WebKitGTK's software compositing
fallback before creating the window while preserving an explicit user override.

## Shared drives and mobile uploads

- Discover shared drives created on another device signed into the same Telegram account.
- Offer Photo library uploads in empty editable drives on Android and iOS.
- Avoid a false audio-stream error before playback is ready and remove extra slider borders.

## Desktop update checks

- Fall back to published release metadata when GitHub's API rate limit is exhausted.
- Serialize thumbnail cache publication to avoid concurrent replacement failures on Windows.
